column1: # LBCH-2026-001 — CAUSAL PARTITION of the sigCheck over-bills vs BCHN.
# BCHN on 2,384 of 4,467 vectors". That number is measured against a BROKEN COMPARAND and must not
# be cited. BCHN's VerifyScript (bchn-src/src/script/interpreter.cpp:2677) accumulates into a LOCAL
# 'metrics' (:2691) and copies it to the caller's 'metricsOut' at exactly two sites, :2745 and :2794,
# BOTH success returns (upstream's own comment at :2744 reads "must set metricsOut for all successful
# returns"). Every failure return leaves metricsOut untouched. bch-conformance's bchn-leg passes a
# default-constructed object (legs/bchn/bchn-leg.cpp:315) and reads it unconditionally (:323-325), so
# on EVERY reject it reports 0/0/0 — an initializer, not a measurement.
# MEASURED, not inferred: over all 5,803 vectors of the 11 signature families under --mode consensus,
# the leg's 3,453 rejects span 9 distinct native_error classes and have exactly ONE distinct metric
# signature: op_cost=0, hash_iters=0, sig_checks=0, op_cost_limit=null. Positive control: op_cost_limit
# is populated on 2,350/2,350 accepts and 0/3,453 rejects — the SetScriptLimits(:2695)-copied-only-on-
# success signature. 'ruwzjq' is self-refuting: rejected for "VM cost limit exceeded" at op_cost=0.
# HOW THE COMPARAND WAS REPAIRED. A new instrument, bchn-partial-probe, transcribes VerifyScript's
# body verbatim (same flags, same order, same EvalScript calls, same P2SH / CLEANSTACK /
# INPUT_SIGCHECKS gates) with ONE change: the metrics object is the caller's, so BCHN's real accrual
# up to its error point is observable. BCHN's sources are NOT modified; it links the same static libs.
# PROBE VALIDATION (before any use): over all 5,803 vectors it agrees with bchn-leg on 5,803/5,803
# verdicts, on the native_error string for all 3,453 rejects, and on all three metrics for all 2,350
# DRIVER VALIDATION (before any use): costprobe + the libauth driver reproduce all 1,486 rows of
# LBCH-2026-001-fix-deltas.tsv on three independent columns (sigChecksAfter, libauthSigChecks,
# opCostAfter) with 0 mismatches, and the libauth driver reproduces the 0u4tu8 root-cause witness
# All four published triples were REPRODUCED before being partitioned: vs libauth before
# THE PARTITION of the 2,384 leg-reported over-bills (disjoint; sums to 2,384):
#   436  A-leg-artifact-agree   LeanBCH's count EQUALS BCHN's real accrual. Pure instrument artifact.
#   638  B1-sig-verify-fail     BCHN aborted at SIG_NULLFAIL: a non-empty signature failed verification.
#  1052  B2-sig-encoding-fail   BCHN aborted at SIG_HASHTYPE (666) / SIG_NONSCHNORR (276) /
#                               SIG_BADLENGTH (110): a non-empty signature failed encoding.
#    26  D1-pubkey-encoding-fail BCHN aborted at PUBKEYTYPE — the PUBKEY, not a signature, was malformed.
#   232  D2-checkbits-malformed BCHN aborted at INVALID_BIT_COUNT (228) / INVALID_BITFIELD_SIZE (4),
#                               before reaching any signature at all.
#  2384  total.  1,948 of these are GENUINE over-bills against BCHN's real accrual; 436 are not.
# MECHANISM (source-verified, both paths). BCHN tallies a signature check only AFTER that check has
# passed. Schnorr multisig: encoding check interpreter.cpp:1598, CheckSig :1606, NULLFAIL return
# :1611, and only then TallySigChecks(1) at :1616. Legacy ECDSA multisig: the NULLFAIL return sits at
# :1686, BEFORE the bulk TallySigChecks(nKeysCount) at :1692 — so a failed ECDSA multisig with a
# non-null signature tallies NOTHING, not nKeysCount. Every one of the 7 error classes above is raised
# only inside case OP_CHECKSIG/VERIFY (:1399-1448), OP_CHECKDATASIG/VERIFY (:1449-1495) or
# OP_CHECKMULTISIG/VERIFY (:1496-1710) — verified by grepping every ScriptError:: raise site.
# LeanBCH bills the leading non-empty signature run; BCHN's accrual stops at, and EXCLUDES, the first
# failing signature. Hence LeanBCH >= BCHN on all 1,948, delta 1..20, measured, never below.
# SOUNDNESS, against the REPAIRED comparand: LeanBCH under-bills BCHN on 324 vectors; all 324 are
# vectors LeanBCH REJECTS and BCHN accepts; 0 occur on a LeanBCH accept. On the 1,547 vectors BOTH
# engines accept, LeanBCH equals BCHN on sigChecks 1,547/1,547 exactly.
#             createVirtualMachineBch2026(); verify() for the verdict, evaluate().metrics for counts
# cause: agree | A-leg-artifact-agree | B1-* | B2-* | D1-* | D2-* | X-over-on-bchn-accept | U-under-bill
# bchnLegSig is what bch-conformance's leg reports (0 on every reject — DO NOT compare against it).
# bchnTrueSig is BCHN's real accrual at its stopping point. Compare against THAT.
